title: Family piano and a sister who played
summary: The family always kept a piano for rehearsals, and an older sister played pleasantly at home.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You don't have a piano in your home when you were a boy? Oh yeah, yeah, we always had a piano. Rehearsal.

Yeah, we had a piano. Well my brother always kept a piano around the house because they, for rehearsing and so on, you know, we always had a piano in the house until the late years then. We all split up then. I don't know what become of it, I guess. They just got rid of it. It got old. But we had a piano in the house.

I wonder if there's anything about the style of the music you can tell us. When you were a boy just coming up starting to go to dances. Has it changed much that you can remember? Of course, I mean we know there's all the rock and roll, but I mean as far as the Dixieland, what they call Dixieland bands today. The Dixieland bands are- The type that they use today, is it much different than your father who played do you think?
